status: UNCONFIRMED - these defaults are hypotheses, not measured game mappings

direction.note: Horizontal canonical zero is +z, positive is toward +x; vertical zero is horizontal, positive is upward. Position and angle mappings are independent settings; both must be calibrated.

spin.note: Positive topBottom is hypothesized topspin; positive leftRight is merely the positive sidespin command, not a verified left/right bend. Native spin units and signs are unknown.

notes: Do not treat this file or its generated pack as calibrated or game-ready.
The default angular mapping guesses degrees. The default speed and spin mappings guess SI units.
Affine field transforms cannot correct drag, Magnus force, collisions, nonlinear slider mappings, or unknown launch-direction formulas.
Change measured anchors and conversion factors here and rerun generate.py. Remeasure trajectories afterward.
